mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a general contractor and a foundation repair coordinator?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general contractor oversees the entire construction of a project, which can include various trades. A foundation repair coordinator, while often part of a general construction company like Hometelligent Inc., specializes specifically in the intricacies of foundation-related projects. Their focus is on the unique engineering, permitting, and construction requirements of foundation repair, offering a deeper expertise in diagnosing specific structural issues and managing the specialized repair process.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor manages overall construction, while a foundation repair coordinator specializes in the specific engineering and permitting of foundation projects.
